title: WHO Vaccine PreQual DB - Finished Vaccine Products
description:
WHO Vaccine PreQual DB - Finished Vaccine Products.
Logical model for the WHO PreQual DB as provided by the backend API at:
     https://extranet.who.int/prequal/vaccines/prequalified-vaccines
This model provides authoritative vaccine product IDs and a richer data structure compared to the CSV export.
Sub-objects with Identification.Id are modeled as separate logical models and linked via references.

Key fields from the API (FinishedVaccineProducts):
  ProductDetails.Identification.Id - Vaccine Product ID (authoritative)
  ProductDetails.Identification.Name - Product reference name (e.g. FVP-P-447)
  ProductDetails.Type - Product type code (e.g. Finished Vaccine Product)
  ProductDetails.DateOfPreQualifiedAcceptance - Date of prequalification
  ProductDetails.AssessmentProcedure - Assessment procedure code
  ProductDetails.ApplicantOrganization - Manufacturer/applicant with ID, name, address
  ProductDetails.Presentation - Presentation form (Vial, Ampoule, etc.)
  ProductDetails.PharmaceuticalForm - Pharmaceutical form details
  ProductDetails.DosageDetails.NoOfDosagesPerPrimaryContainer - Number of doses
  ProductDetails.NRADetails - Responsible NRA with ID, name, address
  ProductDetails.VaccineDetails - Vaccine type with full, abbreviated, and commercial names
  ProductDetails.StorageDetails - Storage temperature and shelf life
  ProductDetails.Status - Prequalification status code

Cardinality note:
Only productId, productName and status are mandatory. Everything else is
optional, because the source database de-publishes a product's detail when
it leaves prequalified status: the record is retained with its identity,
final status and publishing timestamp, and every other field is cleared.
Those records are the authoritative history of a past prequalification, so
the model has to be able to express them. A small number of currently
prequalified products are also missing an individual field where a
Salesforce denormalized name was never populated.
Do not restore 1..1 on these elements without re-checking the live data;
an earlier version of this model asserted that several were always present,
which a full extract disproved.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for FinishedVaccineProducts logical model

productType.description: Product type code from PreQualDatabaseMetadata (e.g. FinishedVaccineProduct). Absent on de-published records.

dateOfPrequal.description: Date of prequalification acceptance. Absent on de-published records, and on a small number of prequalified products where the API does not carry it.

assessmentProcedure.description: Assessment procedure code from PreQualDatabaseMetadata (e.g. PrequalificationStandard)

status.description: Product status code from PreQualDatabaseMetadata (e.g. Prequalified)

presentation.description: Presentation (e.g. Vial, Ampoule). Absent on de-published records.

numDoses.description: Number of doses per primary container

vaccineCommercialName.description: Vaccine commercial name. Absent on de-published records.

vaccineType.description: Vaccine type, coded from PreQualVaccineType. The code is the abbreviated name (e.g. TDV) and the display is the full name (e.g. Dengue tetravalent vaccine (live, attenuated)).

routeOfAdministration.description: Route of administration code from PreQualDatabaseMetadata

presentationOther.description: Alternative presentation description when Presentation is 'Other'

applicantId.description: Applicant/manufacturer organization ID (may be absent if not yet assigned)

applicantName.description: Applicant/manufacturer organization name. Absent on de-published records, and occasionally empty where the Salesforce denormalized name was not populated.

nraId.description: NRA organization ID (may be absent if not yet assigned)

nraName.description: Responsible NRA name. Absent on de-published records, and occasionally empty where the Salesforce denormalized name was not populated.

manufacturerLM.description: Manufacturer logical model instance reference (linked when ApplicantOrganization.Identification.Id is non-null)

nraLM.description: NRA logical model instance reference (linked when NRADetails.Identification.Id is non-null)

vaccineLM.description: Vaccine logical model instance reference (linked when VaccineDetails.Identification.Id is non-null)

bulkSupplierLM.description: Bulk supplier logical model instance reference (linked when BulkSupplier.Id is non-null)

packagingLM.description: Product packaging logical model instance references

documentLM.description: Document detail logical model instance references

siteLM.description: Site detail logical model instance references

ingredientLM.description: Product ingredient logical model instance references

manufacturerReference.description: Manufacturer FHIR Organization reference. Present only where an applicant name is available, since the Organization instance is keyed on that name.

responsibleNRAReference.description: Responsible NRA FHIR Organization reference. Present only where an NRA name is available, since the Organization instance is keyed on that name.

productReference.description: Product FHIR reference (when available from pcmt dependency)
